description: Request cancellation of a service (VPS, dedicated, hosting) so it stops renewing. `type` is REQUIRED and has very different consequences, so ask the customer which one they want instead of guessing: "End of Billing Period" keeps the service running until the current paid period ends and only stops the next renewal, while "Immediate" gives up the rest of the paid period and the server is torn down — ALL DATA ON IT IS LOST, with no refund for unused time. Offer a backup (`impreza_vps_create_backup`) before an immediate cancellation.

reason.description: Optional reason, stored on the cancellation request. Do not put the customer's personal details here.

service_id.description: The service to cancel (from impreza_list_services or impreza_list_dedicated).

type.description: When to cancel. "End of Billing Period" = keep it until the paid period ends, then stop renewing (the safe default to suggest). "Immediate" = tear it down now and lose the data.

name: impreza_cancel_service
